cloud_model.description: Cloud model for everyday text jobs when on-device isn't available or suitable.

cloud_model_pro.description: Cloud model for heavier jobs: handwriting, diagrams, 3D.

on_device_max_chars.description: Inputs longer than this go straight to the cloud instead of trying on-device first.

transcribe_prefer_cloud.description: Send handwriting transcription to the cloud (best accuracy) instead of on-device first.

on_device_enabled.description: Kill switch: set to false to turn off on-device inference for everyone.
